bridge.kev: Gaps being actively exploited right now: {n}

bridge.demo.kev: List of actively exploited vulnerabilities (CISA KEV), example
bridge.demo.signatures: Signatures for foreign miners, ToyCoin exception stays local
bridge.principles: ToySafe only checks what is yours, never attacks, never asks for your phrase or keys and never sends transactions.
scan.networksHelp: Networks (CIDR) and domains you own. The engine rejects targets outside.
scan.allowPublic: Allow public addresses (only your own servers and domains)
scan.demoExplain: In demo mode a simulated scan runs over the example fleet. Nothing on the network is checked. With your own engine, the form for your devices appears here.
scan.err.confirm: Confirm that you own the targets or have permission.
scan.err.assets: Add at least one named target.
shields.lead: All findings in the order you should work through them: first what is being exploited, then by severity, importance and exposure.
shields.order: The top item is what to tackle first.
radar.lead: Who is on your network? The radar compares every device with your inventory. Unknown devices blink until someone recognises them.
radar.unknownAdvice: Ask family or team first. If nobody knows it, block it in the router and open the playbook.
radar.how: Green dots are known devices; red ones blink because nobody has confirmed them. Select a dot for details.
radar.tip1: Give every device a clear name in the router.
radar.tip2: Cameras, lamps and toys belong in the guest or IoT network.
radar.tip3: New devices in the middle of the night are a reason to ask.
identity.lead: Accounts are the keys to everything else. Practise strong passphrases, set up two-factor protection and check whether someone can fake mail in your name.
identity.labWarn: Practice only. Never enter your wallet phrase or real passwords here. Nothing is stored or sent.
identity.phraseAlarm: This looks like a recovery phrase.
identity.phraseAlarmText: Delete it now. A real phrase belongs on paper or metal only, never in an input field. Nobody in the ToyVerse asks for it.
identity.genInfo: Random from a list of 557 words, rolled with your device's random generator: about {bits} bits.
identity.genNotWallet: Good for password managers, mail and game accounts. Your wallet phrase is created by the TOYPAY wallet itself.
identity.2fa.1: Email first: whoever has your mail can reset everything else.
identity.2fa.2: Password manager with a long passphrase and a second factor.
identity.2fa.3: GitHub, hosting and domain if you run anything.
identity.2fa.4: Game and social accounts, especially with a gang or community.
identity.2fa.5: Print recovery codes and keep them separately.
identity.2faNote: Passkeys and security keys are strongest. An app beats SMS, SMS beats nothing.
identity.mailLead: Without SPF, DKIM and DMARC anyone can send mail that looks like it came from your gang's domain.
pass.common: Contains a very common word from cracking lists.
pass.sequence: Contains a sequence like 1234 or qwer.
pass.year: A year is easy to guess.
pass.moreWords: More random words make it much stronger than special characters.
pass.leet: Digits for letters (P4ssw0rd) are known to every cracker.
vault.lead: Around TOYPAY and your TOY: compare addresses safely, verify downloads and know the ground rules of the ToyVerse.
vault.addrLead: Checks an address's checksum and compares two addresses character by character. That exposes address poisoning: scammers generate addresses whose start and end look the same.
vault.addrA: Address you want to send to
vault.addrB: Address from your address book or confirmed by the recipient
vault.cs.invalid: Not a valid address: 0x followed by 40 characters 0–9 and a–f.
vault.cs.lowercase: Written without checksum. With checksum it reads:
vault.cs.wrong: Checksum wrong: typo or tampered. Do not send!
vault.poisoning: Warning, address poisoning: the first {p} and last {s} characters match, the middle does not. That is exactly what fake addresses look like.
vault.needTwo: Both fields need a complete address.
vault.addrTip: Never copy addresses from your transaction history. Take them from your address book or have them confirmed through a second channel.
vault.dlLead: Downloaded TOYPAY, a node or ToySafe? Compare the fingerprint (SHA-256) with the one on the official page.
vault.dlPick: Choose a file or drop it here
vault.dlLocal: The file stays on your device.
vault.dlExpectedPh: 64 characters or a line from SHA256SUMS
vault.dlMismatch: No match. Delete the file and download only from the official page.
vault.facts: Ground rules that expose every scam
vault.fact.phrase: Nobody ever asks for your phrase or key: no support, no app, no NPC.
vault.fact.onlyToy: The ToyChain only has TOY. No tokens, no NFTs, no smart contracts. Anyone offering a ToyChain token is lying.
vault.fact.oldToken: Old ToyCoin tokens on Polygon and Ethereum are not ToyChain TOY. There is no swap and no bridge.
vault.fact.testnet: Testnet TOY have no value and are never sold.
vault.fact.fair: Total fair launch: no reserve, no presale. Every TOY comes from emission.
vault.fact.accounts: Accounts are never lost. Long-unused accounts only rest and can be woken up. Nobody has to pay for that.
vault.fact.poker: Games with stakes use ducats only, not TOY.
vault.minerText: Only the ToyCoin miner from the TOYPAY wallet is allowed. Any other miner on your devices counts as a break-in: it costs power, heats devices and is often part of a botnet.
vault.noFindings: No foreign miner and no vault findings.
comms.lead: Scams usually arrive as messages. Paste one here: the detector recognises the known tricks in the ToyVerse and checks every link without opening it.
comms.placeholder: Paste mail, chat, SMS or DM here …
comms.local: Runs entirely on your device. Nothing is sent or stored.
comms.ex.support: Hello, this is the official TOYPAY Support. We noticed suspicious activity, your account will be locked in 24 hours! Confirm your 12 words now at https://toypay-verify.xyz and install AnyDesk so we can help you. Don't tell anyone.
comms.ex.swap: Exclusive for ToyCoin holders: swap your old ToyCoin from Polygon 1:1 into ToyChain TOY! Presale today only, guaranteed 300% return. Connect now via t0ychain-bridge.top.
comms.ex.friend: Hey, gang meeting tomorrow at 6 pm in TOYQUEST at the bazaar. Bring your seals, we'll try the Gate of Three Seals.
comms.phraseLeak: The message contains something that looks like a recovery phrase. If it was sent, open the emergency playbook now.
comms.next: Don't reply, don't click. Report the message to moderation or the provider and block the sender.
comms.bookmarksLead: Add the official domains you trust. Anything else using ToyVerse names gets flagged.
comms.wifi1: Never log in to wallets or accounts on foreign Wi-Fi without a VPN.
comms.wifi2: Two networks with the same name? One may be an evil twin.
comms.wifi3: WPS off, WPA3 on, change the router password.
comms.noFindings: No findings from the Wi-Fi watch.
link.userinfo: Contains an @: the real target server comes after it.
link.ip: Numbers instead of a name: reputable services use domains.
link.unicode: Contains special letters that can look like normal ones.
link.shortener: Link shortener: the destination is hidden.
link.tld: Domain ending often used for scams.
link.subdomains: Many subdomains: the real name is often at the very end.
link.brand: Uses a ToyVerse name but is not on your list of safe addresses.
link.lookalike: Imitates a ToyVerse name with swapped characters (e.g. 0 for o).
link.none: Nothing unusual found. Still check that you expected this address.
op.lead: For everyone running something in the ToyVerse: nodes and validators, websites, bots, code and containers. Findings and a blueprint for layered protection.
op.layers: Layered protection for a ToyChain node
op.layersLead: Each layer catches what the previous one lets through.
op.layer.edge.d: Only the P2P port is open. RPC and admin only locally or via VPN.
op.layer.sentry.d: Validators hide behind public sentry nodes and only talk to them.
op.layer.keys.d: Validator key encrypted, permissions 600, never in code, offline backup in two places.
op.layer.host.d: Automatic updates, dedicated user, firewall, SSH keys only, clock in sync.
op.layer.watch.d: Monitoring for blocks, storage budget (256 MB) and time, alerts to your phone.
op.layer.release.d: Signed releases only, compare checksums, vet dependencies with cargo-deny and cargo-vet.
op.headersLead: Checks HTTPS, certificate and security headers of your own website.
op.modulesLive: Green means the tool is installed on the engine host.
op.modulesDemo: This is how the engine works. Each module calls a proven tool and explains the result.
engine.needed: This check needs your own ToySafe engine.
engine.ownOnly: Only check your own domains and sites.
em.lead: Stay calm, one step at a time. Pick what happened. Each plan guides you through detect, contain, eradicate, recover and learn.
em.question: What happened?
em.contactsNote: In acute danger call the emergency number first. ToySafe does not replace the police or legal advice.
log.lead: Every scan lands in the logbook. Download reports and share them with your team.
log.noHistory: No scans on this engine yet.
log.demoHistory: Demo mode only has the example scan.
log.privacy: Reports contain details about your devices. Only share them with people helping to fix things.
crew.lead: Protection works best together. Help family, friends and your gang, and make moderation strong against scams.
crew.cardLead: Five rules on one card for the fridge, the desk or the gang channel. Choose who it is for.
crew.name: Name on the card (optional)
crew.rule.kids.1: My password belongs only to me and my parents.
crew.rule.kids.2: If someone says "don't tell anyone", I talk to an adult I trust right away.
crew.rule.kids.3: Gifts in exchange for passwords, photos or accounts don't exist. It is always a trick.
crew.rule.kids.4: I don't click links from strangers, not even in the game.
crew.rule.kids.5: If something feels strange, I may block, report and get help.
crew.rule.elders.1: Banks, police and support never ask for a password, PIN or TAN.
crew.rule.elders.2: When rushed or pressured: hang up and call back yourself using the number from the directory.
crew.rule.elders.3: Never allow remote access to my computer to someone I didn't call myself.
crew.rule.elders.4: Don't tap links in SMS and mail; open the website yourself.
crew.rule.elders.5: When in doubt, ask the family. Better once too often.
crew.rule.gang.1: We only check what is ours or what we have permission for.
crew.rule.gang.2: Phrases and keys stay offline; nobody asks for them, nobody hands them over.
crew.rule.gang.3: Admin accounts with two-factor, permissions only as needed.
crew.rule.gang.4: Whoever sees something suspicious reports it in the gang channel, no shame.
crew.rule.gang.5: We help newcomers and share knowledge instead of fear.
crew.rule.mods.1: Secure evidence: screenshot with time and sender before deleting.
crew.rule.mods.2: Remove scams right away and warn without exposing victims.
crew.rule.mods.3: Never offer phrases, keys or remote access, not even "to help".
crew.rule.mods.4: Only pass on official links from the pinned list.
crew.rule.mods.5: For extortion or danger to children: involve the platform and the police.
crew.cardFooter: ToySafe, protection for the ToyVerse. In an emergency: open the Emergency station.
crew.mod.1: Secure the message (screenshot, link, sender, time).
crew.mod.2: Check it in the comms detector and note the trick it found.
crew.mod.3: Remove it, block the sender, post a short warning without victims' names.
crew.mod.4: Contact those affected privately and point them to the right emergency playbook.
crew.mod.5: Report the trick to the team so the detector's rules can grow.
crew.modNote: Moderators never see balances and never touch accounts. On the ToyChain, locks only happen under fixed rules.
set.lead: Connection to your own engine, appearance and your data.
set.notConnected: No engine reachable. You are seeing demo data.
set.baseHelp: Leave empty if the engine serves this cockpit itself.
set.tokenHelp: The token of your own engine (TOYSAFE_API_TOKEN), not your wallet. It stays in this browser only.
set.auth.token: The engine requires an access token.
set.auth.local-only: The engine only accepts commands from its own computer.
set.langNote: The interface is available in German and English. Content such as missions and playbooks is still German; more languages follow the ToyVerse list.
set.priv.1: Never asks for your phrase, private key or wallet password.
set.priv.2: Sends no transactions and holds no keys.
set.priv.3: Loads nothing from third parties: no trackers, no external fonts, no ads.
set.priv.4: Only checks what is yours and logs every authorisation.
set.priv.5: Never attacks. All modules orchestrate proven, defensive tools.
set.dataLead: Ticks, inventory, safe addresses and game progress live only in this browser.
set.about: ToySafe is part of the ToyVerse. Open source under the MIT licence.

game.replayed: Replayed: stars count, ducats only the first time.

game.practiceOnly: Practice passphrase: make up a new one. Never enter a real one.

game.findWrong: Not quite. Look at time, place and permissions again.

assets.err.json: The file is not valid JSON.
assets.err.list: Expected a list of 1 to 256 targets.
assets.err.item: Each target needs a unique id, a name and a valid asset_type.
